mapper.select: SELECT TERMS_ID, TERMS_TITLE, TERMS_VERSION, REQUIRED_YN, CATEGORY, CONTENT, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, REG_DT FROM TB_TERMS WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT TERMS_ID, TERMS_TITLE, TERMS_VERSION, REQUIRED_YN, CATEGORY, CONTENT, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, REG_DT FROM TB_TERMS WHERE TERMS_ID = #{termsId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TERMS_AGREE_LOG ( REQ_TX_SEQ, TERMS_ID, AGREE_YN, AGREE_DT ) VALUES ( #{reqTxSeq}, #{termsId}, #{agreeYn}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO TB_CERT_LOG ( REQ_TX_SEQ, CHANNEL_TYPE, AUTH_METHOD, CUST_NM, BIRTH_DATE, CELL_NO, CI_VAL, AUTH_TOKEN, AUTH_STATUS, ERR_CODE, ERR_MSG, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, REQ_DT ) VALUES ( #{reqTxSeq}, #{channelType}, #{authMethod}, #{custNm}, #{birthDate}, #{cellNo}, #{ciVal}, #{authToken}, #{authStatus}, #{errCode}, #{errMsg}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CERT_LOG SET AUTH_STATUS = #{authStatus}, CI_VAL = #{ciVal}, ERR_CODE = #{errCode}, ERR_MSG = #{errMsg}, RES_DT = NOW() WHERE REQ_TX_SEQ = #{reqTxSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT CERT_SEQ, REQ_TX_SEQ, CHANNEL_TYPE, AUTH_METHOD, CUST_NM, BIRTH_DATE, CELL_NO, CI_VAL, AUTH_TOKEN, AUTH_STATUS, ERR_CODE, ERR_MSG, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, REQ_DT, RES_DT FROM TB_CERT_LOG WHERE REQ_TX_SEQ = #{reqTxSeq}
SELECT WATCH_SEQ, CI_VAL, CUST_NM, RISK_GRADE, RISK_TYPE, RISK_REASON, BLOCK_YN, REG_DT, REG_USER_ID FROM TB_WATCHLIST WHERE CI_VAL = #{ciVal}
SELECT CI_VAL, DI_VAL, CUST_ID, CUST_NM, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, NATIONAL_INFO, CELL_NO, REG_DT, MOD_DT FROM TB_CUST_CI WHERE CI_VAL = #{ciVal}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CUST_CI ( CI_VAL, DI_VAL, CUST_ID, CUST_NM, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, NATIONAL_INFO, CELL_NO, REG_DT, MOD_DT ) VALUES ( #{ciVal}, #{diVal}, #{custId}, #{custNm}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{nationalInfo}, #{cellNo}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DI_VAL = VALUES(DI_VAL), CUST_NM = VALUES(CUST_NM), BIRTH_DATE = VALUES(BIRTH_DATE), GENDER = VALUES(GENDER), NATIONAL_INFO = VALUES(NATIONAL_INFO), CELL_NO = VALUES(CELL_NO), MOD_DT = NOW()
